source.text: A case with one fault: a film coefficient of zero in the history (an adiabatic wall is not accepted; the least is 0.001 W/m2/K). FEED must refuse it before any run; SEED reports E_OUT_OF_RANGE.
source.check: FEED's schema vectors (schema/vectors/bad/boundary-history-zero-h.json) assert the same code in FEED's own test suite.
